name: Login (sub-flow)
description: Domain starter-pack template (E13, Pillar F). A parameterized, reusable login sub-flow — call it from another flow via a `callSubFlow` step with { email, pw } params, or run it standalone (it supplies its own ${secret:...}-backed default fixtures below, so it's independently runnable green after only credential/env substitution, per spec AC4). Selector-bearing steps reference shared/library.ts entries by id ("libraryRef") instead of hardcoding a locator, so the SAME steps resolve correctly on both a mobile build and a browser build (spec AC2) — a real project swaps the library's placeholder locator values for the actual inspected ones once real device/browser access is available.
